proof:
Source. Simon Ch. 3, §4: the definition of locally finite perimeter and (4.1) (chapter-03.txt lines 555-573), with Ch. 2, (2.1) (chapter-02.txt lines 477-484). The book states only the direction χ_E ∈ BV_loc(U) ⇒ (4.1). This converse is Steps 1-2 of the parent proof, with details given here.

1. U is open by hypothesis.

2. Local integrability. χ_E is the indicator of E of the constant 1. Since E is L^N-null-measurable, χ_E is L^N-a.e. strongly measurable, and 0 ≤ χ_E ≤ 1. Every compact set, in particular every closed ball, has finite Lebesgue measure, so χ_E is integrable on a neighbourhood of every point. Hence χ_E is locally integrable on ℝ^N, and a fortiori on U.

3. (R1) Let g be C¹ with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ W ⊆ U.
- div g = trace Dg is continuous, because Dg is continuous.
- div g vanishes outside tsupport g: g ≡ 0 on the open set ℝ^N ∖ tsupport g, so Dg = 0 there (SimonGMT Chapter02.support_euclideanDivergence_subset).
Hence div g is bounded with compact support and L^N-integrable. Null-measurability of E lets us identify integrals of indicators with restricted integrals, so
∫_W χ_E div g dL^N = ∫ 1_W 1_E div g dL^N = ∫ 1_E div g dL^N = ∫ 1_U 1_E div g dL^N = ∫_{E∩U} div g dL^N.
The middle equalities hold because 1_W div g = div g = 1_U div g, as div g = 0 off tsupport g ⊆ W ⊆ U.

4. (R2) Let g be continuous with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U, and let M_g := sup_x |g(x)| < ∞. The function x ↦ ⟨g(x), ν(x)⟩ is μ-a.e. strongly measurable. For μ-a.e. x (those with |ν(x)| = 1),
|⟨g(x), ν(x)⟩| ≤ |g(x)| |ν(x)| = |g(x)| ≤ M_g 1_{tsupport g}(x).
As tsupport g is a compact subset of U, μ(tsupport g) < ∞. Hence ⟨g, ν⟩ is μ-integrable and |∫⟨g, ν⟩ dμ| ≤ M_g μ(tsupport g).

5. The BV bound. Let W be open with W̄ compact and W̄ ⊆ U, and put c := μ(W̄). This is a real number ≥ 0, finite because W̄ is a compact subset of U. Let g be a C¹ compactly supported continuous field with tsupport g ⊆ W. Then g is C¹ with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U. By step 3, the Gauss–Green identity (GG) of the pair, and step 4,
∫_W χ_E div g = ∫_{E∩U} div g = −∫⟨g, ν⟩ dμ ≤ |∫⟨g, ν⟩ dμ| ≤ M_g μ(tsupport g) ≤ M_g μ(W̄) = c · M_g.
The last inequality uses tsupport g ⊆ W ⊆ W̄ and monotonicity of μ. Finally, M_g = sup_x |g(x)| is SimonGMT's compactlySupportedSupNorm g = sSup {|g(x)| : x ∈ ℝ^N}. This set of reals is nonempty and bounded above, since g is continuous with compact support.

6. Steps 1, 2 and 5 are exactly the three clauses of IsLocallyBV U χ_E, i.e. HasLocallyFinitePerimeter U E.
key_steps: U is open by hypothesis; χ_E is bounded and a.e. measurable (E null-measurable), hence locally integrable.
(R1): for C¹ g with tsupport g ⊆ W ⊆ U, ∫_W χ_E div g = ∫_{E∩U} div g because div g vanishes off tsupport g.
(R2): ⟨g, ν⟩ is μ-integrable and |∫⟨g, ν⟩dμ| ≤ sup|g| · μ(tsupport g).
With c := μ(W̄), (GG) gives ∫_W χ_E div g = −∫⟨g, ν⟩dμ ≤ c · sup|g|, which is the IsLocallyBV bound.
